description: This file defines structures, function prototypes, and constants for writing and managing reftable data structures, including options, statistics, and writer operations.

methods.name: reftable_writer_new
methods.description: Creates a new reftable writer with specified options and callback functions.

methods.name: reftable_writer_set_limits
methods.description: Sets the range of update indices for subsequent record additions.

methods.name: reftable_writer_add_ref
methods.description: Adds a single reftable reference record to the writer.

methods.name: reftable_writer_add_refs
methods.description: Adds multiple reftable reference records, sorting them before adding.

methods.name: reftable_writer_add_log
methods.description: Adds a log record keyed by (refname, decreasing update_index).

methods.name: reftable_writer_add_logs
methods.description: Adds multiple log records, sorting them before adding.

methods.name: reftable_writer_close
methods.description: Finalizes the reftable, allowing statistics to be inspected.

methods.name: reftable_writer_stats
methods.description: Returns statistics about the reftable being written.
